# f5os_portgroup (Resource)

Manage the mode of a hardware-defined port group on an F5OS rSeries appliance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5os_portgroup" "example" {
  name = "5"
  mode = "MODE_10GB"
}

resource "f5os_portgroup" "with_ddm" {
  name               = "5"
  mode               = "MODE_25GB"
  ddm_poll_frequency = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Port group mode supported by the appliance.
- `name` (String) Hardware-defined port group name, for example `1/1`.

### Optional

- `ddm_poll_frequency` (Number) Digital diagnostic monitoring polling frequency.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
